ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Heading.helper: Enter the heading to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SubHeading.helper: Enter the sub heading to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ImageBefore.helper: Choose the image or file to use for image before. Use a clear file that fits this content.

ImageAfter.helper: Choose the image or file to use for image after. Use a clear file that fits this content.
